Output: 1. Managing tariffs and subsidies (i) Clear policies on tariffs and subsidies that are targeted at low-income customers (ii) Ensure policy implementation through NEPRA rules and guidelines (iii) Reduction of discretionary policy decisions and of lag in tariff approval and implementation Indicator: DISCO tariff determination reduced from more than 7 months after submission of petition (2013) for all DISCOs to within 4 months by June 2017 Progress/Status: Ongoing. Target still feasible. DISCOs submitted to NEPRA tariff petitions for FY2014-2015, including forms and data requirements in the Tariff and Subsidy Policy Guidelines, for NEPRA to start tariff determination; and 5 DISCOs submitted 5 year investment plans for NEPRA to start determining multiyear tariff in FY2015-16. Data Source: NEPRA website Actual value:

Output: 2. Improving sector performance and market access for private sector participation (i) Reducing losses and improving collection rate of DISCOs (ii) Improving demand-side efficiency and strengthening energy conservation (iii) Managing generation costs through least-cost planning, and ensuring that new power generation plants follow the plan (iv) Increasing gas supply and opening the gas market to direct contracting between producers and large-volume gas consumers (v) Commercializing and improving the performance of public sector power companies (vi) Institutionalizing the commercial operations of the CPPA Indicator: Improvement in collection rate of DISCOs from 86% in 2012 to 94% of total billing by 2017 Progress/Status: Ongoing. Target still feasible. MoWP instructed PESCO, HESCO, SEPCO and MEPCO to outsource collections functions for customers at the worst performing 25% feeders in their networks. MEPCO and PESCO have outsourced collections, but HESCO and SEPCO have not. MoWP reports that the revenue-based load shedding and billing outsourcing combined have resulted in loss reductions. MoWP provided the Fact-finding Mission for Subprogram 2 (February 2015) with information on outcome and impacts of outsourcing for MEPCO and PESCO, including monthly performance data. Discussions on the results of outsourcing are underway. Data Source: NEPRA state of industry report Actual value:

Output: 1. Managing tariffs and subsidies (i) Clear policies on tariffs and subsidies that are targeted at low-income customers (ii) Ensure policy implementation through NEPRA rules and guidelines (iii) Reduction of discretionary policy decisions and of lag in tariff approval and implementation Indicator: Guidelines for DISCO tariff determination covering methodologies, timetable, formula, and procedures for both annual and multi-year tariffs, procedure for earlier submission on investment costs by DISCOs, and forward-looking automatic FPA notified by NEPRA by December 2014 and implemented Progress/Status: Done. The Guidelines were notified on 16 January 2015 (SRO 34(1) 2015), became effective, and uploaded to the NEPRA website. All DISCOS, except TEPCO, submitted multiyear investment plans, which were reviewed by NEPRA. Meetings and exchanges between NEPRA and DISCOs are underway to enhance the investment plans to be used for the multiyear tariff determination next FY. Data Source: NEPRA website Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2014 Baseline value: N Target year: 2014 Target value: Y
